modern: Another may be more expert in throwing his opponent; but he is not more sociable, nor more modest, nor better disciplined to meet all that happens, nor more considerate towards the faults of his neighbours.
original: Another may be more expert in casting his opponent; but he is not more social, nor more modest, nor better disciplined to meet all that happens, nor more considerate with respect to the faults of his neighbors.
notification: Another may be more expert in throwing his opponent…
